svg.aria-label: Breadboard layout of the capstone climate monitor
svg.text: Capstone on the breadboard: sensor, display, LED and button
The modules hang on short jumper wires above the top breadboard; the lower half is Lesson 1 mirrored

g.text: J3 (pin names as printed on the board)

svg.text: Top rails: + is 3V3 (fed from J2 pin 3V3 through the bottom + rail and the long wire on the left), − is GND from J3.
Both SCL wires land in the GPIO22 strip, both SDA wires in the GPIO21 strip. W1: GPIO25 → R1 → LED1. W2: GPIO33 → S1.
Check before power: no wire joins a + rail to a − rail, and nothing goes to the 5V pin.
